Frequently Asked Questions

Cosmetic surgery options may include facial procedures such as rhinoplasty, facelift, eyelid surgery and chin or facial contouring, as well as breast and body procedures such as breast augmentation, breast lift, breast reduction, liposuction and tummy tuck. The procedures available at our clinic depend on your individual needs and suitability.

The right procedure depends on your concerns, anatomy, goals, medical history and expectations. During a consultation, your surgeon can assess your requirements, explain suitable options, discuss potential risks and help you understand what each procedure can and cannot achieve.

The cost of cosmetic surgery varies depending on the procedure, complexity, surgical technique, hospital or facility charges, anaesthesia and other individual factors. A personalised cost estimate can be provided after your consultation and treatment assessment.

Recovery varies significantly depending on the procedure and individual healing. Some procedures involve a shorter recovery, while major surgeries may require several weeks before you can return fully to normal activities. Your surgeon will provide procedure-specific recovery and activity guidelines.

Most surgical procedures involve incisions and therefore some degree of scarring. Surgeons generally place incisions strategically and use appropriate closure techniques to make scars as inconspicuous as possible. However, scar formation varies from person to person and scars cannot always be completely eliminated.

The longevity of cosmetic surgery results depends on the procedure, ageing, lifestyle, weight changes and other individual factors. Some surgical changes can be long-lasting, but natural ageing continues after surgery. Your surgeon can explain how long results are typically expected to last for your specific procedure.

In selected patients, multiple cosmetic procedures may be performed together. Whether combining procedures is appropriate depends on your health, the procedures involved, operative time and overall safety. Your surgeon will assess whether a combined approach is suitable for you.

Initial improvements may be visible soon after surgery, but swelling and bruising can temporarily affect the appearance. Final results may take weeks or months to develop, depending on the procedure. Some procedures, such as rhinoplasty, can take considerably longer for swelling to fully settle.

You can contact our clinic to schedule a consultation in Bangalore. During your appointment, you can discuss your aesthetic concerns, treatment goals and suitable procedure options with the surgeon. A personalised treatment plan can then be recommended based on your assessment.
